==Problem==
When <math>0.000315</math> is multiplied by <math>7,928,564</math> the product is closest to which of the following?

<math>\textbf{(A) }210\qquad\textbf{(B) }240\qquad\textbf{(C) }2100\qquad\textbf{(D) }2400\qquad\textbf{(E) }24000</math>

==Solution==
We can approximate <imath>7,928,564</imath> to <imath>8,000,000</imath> and <imath>0.000315</imath> to <imath>0.0003.</imath> Multiplying the two yields <imath>2400. </imath> Thus, it shows our answer is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(D)}\ 2400}.</imath>

~edits by Tarmac-boy
